newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Domenici says budget talks as expected.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Domenici says budget talks as expected.

text.p: Senate Budget Committee chairman Pete Domenici said Tuesday budget talks with Democrats and the White House were proceeding as expected.

"We got done what was expected would get done," the New Mexico Republican said as lawmakers quickly ended the day's budget negotiations with White House budget director Frank Raines and other administration officials.

His Democratic counterpart, Sen. Frank Lautenberg of New Jersey and Democratic Rep. John Spratt of South Carolina told reporters the talks were difficult. The talks concluded about an hour early and were scheduled to resume Wednesday.
